$comment: SDK conventions layered on top of the connector-js algo oracle. The generator applies these when emitting src/types/algo.wave8.types.ts. Every entry needs a reason — this file is the review surface for deliberate divergences from the upstream OpenAPI typing.

numericStringFields.$comment: Oracle types these as string; the SDK's established convention (Wave 1, asserted by test/resources/ConvertAndAlgo.test.ts) transforms decimal-amount strings to number at the parse boundary so consumers get numeric amounts. Applied by field name across all interfaces of this product.

flexibleIdFields.$comment: None for algo: the established SDK algo types keep algoId/orderId/subId as numbers (Binance algo ids are well inside 2^53), which is what the oracle already types them as (number | bigint -> z.number()). Listed explicitly so the next rung knows the knob was considered.
